text:
sara_sales: Hey all, Polybridge is evaluating a switch from CompetitorX to Redwood. They want a focused POC: confirm prompt/output parity, verify security controls, and get a clear pricing delta. They attached their security questionnaire (link: https://polybridge.internal/sec-q-2026.pdf) and asked for timeline guidance.

jordan_se: High-level checklist to scope POC: 1) map CompetitorX endpoints -> Redwood endpoints; 2) collect 500 representative requests for A/B; 3) agreement on parity metrics (exact token match, top-1 semantic match, and acceptable delta %); 4) streaming/function-calling compatibility; 5) load profile for sizing (QPS, avg tokens).

kevin_polybridge: Goals: ~95% parity on production prompts, ability to route non-critical traffic to cheaper variants, predictable monthly cost. Security needs: KMS for keys, VPC peering or private deployment, SOC2 artifacts. Timeline: 4-6 weeks for POC.

marta_security: We can complete questionnaire but need clarification: do you require customer-managed KMS (BYOK) for the POC? HSM-backed keys? Also whether logs must be shipped to their Splunk/Datadog instance.

nisha_legal: From contract side we need data residency commitments and a documented deletion workflow for any cached KV/prefixes. Also will propose standard indemnity and export control language.

ryan_account: Rough pricing guidance: hosted API example model ~ $0.0035 per 1k prompt tokens + $0.008 per 1k completion tokens; 1M tokens/month typically in the $2k-$3k range depending on prompt/completion ratio and caching. Dedicated pool is fixed monthly + lower unit costs. We can offer a 20% POC usage discount. Need concurrency and peak QPS to quote Dedicated.

kevin_polybridge: Peak concurrency ~150 QPS, average completion ~200-300 tokens, ~60% of traffic is streaming. They prefer <200ms median for simple prompts.

jordan_se: For that profile we recommend Dedicated with autoscale and continuous batching. Enable prefix/KV caching to cut repeated tokens (~25-35% token savings typically). Note: function-calling semantics differ slightly vs CompetitorX; we'll provide a mapping shim for the POC to normalise call/response events. For validation, we'll run parallel traffic and compare outputs using a lightweight comparator. Example compare flow (informal): curl competitor -> comp.json; curl redwood -> red.json; run compare script to compute levenshtein and embedding-similarity.

marta_security: We'll assemble SOC2 summary, redacted pen test, and KMS integration notes. Hosted API supports cloud KMS with constrained policies; Private supports customer-managed keys and HSM.

deploy-bot: Created TICKET-5481 for POC infra. Staging cluster ETA: 3 business days to provision. Please provide CIDR for peering and one admin IAM role.

sara_sales: Action items: @kevin_polybridge upload 500 sample payloads + questionnaire answers to TICKET-5481; @jordan_se produce mapping shim and POC test plan; @marta_security and @nisha_legal prep artifacts and contract markups. Schedule 30-min sync next Mon 11am PT.

kevin_polybridge: I'll upload samples and confirm CIDR today. Thanks! :thumbsup:
